description: Return the full fact sheet for a tax lot by 10-digit BBL (borough-block-lot, e.g. 3030090016) or by 7-digit DOB building number (BIN). Requires "bbl" or "bin" (if both are sent, bbl is used).

bbl.description: 10-digit BBL (borough-block-lot), e.g. "3030090016". Send it as text. Required unless "bin" is given.

bin.description: 7-digit DOB building number (BIN), e.g. "3070696". Send it as text. Required unless "bbl" is given.

name: get_property
title: Get a NYC property by BBL or BIN
